scenario: Correcting mistake of saying 'interested to' instead of 'interested in'
highlights: if the board were interested in bonds
pattern: If + Subject + were + interested in + Noun, would + V1
en: If the board were interested in bonds, the broker would present them.
tr: Kurul tahvillerle ilgilenseydi, broker onları sunardı.
ipa: /ɪf ðə bɔːd wɜːr ˈɪntrəstɪd ɪn bɒndz ðə ˈbrəʊkə wʊd prɪˈzɛnt ðəm/
trPron: if dı bord vör intırestid in bondz dı brovkır vud prizent dım
tense: 'Interested' sıfatı daima 'in' edatına kilitlidir. Kurulun şu an tahvillerle ilgilenmediği bilindiğinden, hayali koşul Past Simple ('were interested') ile kurulur.
collocations: stock broker pointing financial graphs display board ledger
commonMistake: If the board would be interested with bonds, broker... ❌
